paite: TOUPA, David haksat thuaknate tengteng theihpih in;
heading: Tempul Phatna
english: A Song of Ascents. Yahweh, remember David and all his affliction,

paite: TOUPA kiang a kichiam a, Jakob Mihatpa kiang a thu achiamdan;
english: how he swore to Yahweh, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:

paite: "Ka omna inn a biakbuk ah ka lut kei dia, ka lupna ah ka kah sam kei ding hi.
english: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;

paite: Ka mitte ihmut ka phal kei ding a, ka mitte asin uh leng ka phal sam kei ding,
english: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,

paite: TOUPA mun ding ka zonkhiak masiah, Jakob Mi Hatpa omna ding," chi in.
english: until I find out a place for Yahweh, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”

paite: Ngai in, athu Ephrathah ah ka za ua; sing gam ah ka muta uhi.
english: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar.

paite: Amah biakbuk ah ka lut ding ua; akhe ngakna bul ah ka be ding uhi.
english: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.”

paite: TOUPA aw, thou inla, na khawlmun ding ah lut in; nang leh na hatna bawm.
english: Arise, Yahweh, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.

paite: Na siampute diktatna in kivan uhenla; na misiangthoute nuamsa in kikou uhen.
english: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!

paite: Na sikha David ziak in na thaunilh mel kiheisak nawn ke'n.
english: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.

paite: David kiang ah thutak in TOUPA akichiamta a; alehngatsan kei ding hi; "Na pumpi gah a mi laltutphah ah ka tusak ding.
english: Yahweh has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.

paite: Na tate'n ka thukhun leh ka thu theihsak, amau ka hilh ding azuih uleh, atate uh leng tangtawn in na laltutphah ah atu zel ding uh," chi in.
english: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”

paite: TOUPA'N Zion lah atel ngal a; a-omna ding in adeih hi.
english: For Yahweh has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.

paite: Hiai tangtawn a ding a ka khawlmun ding ahi; hiai ah ka om nilouh ding; ka deihlam ahi ngal a.
english: “This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.

paite: Anek ding tampi in ka vualzawl dia; amigentheite uh tanghou in ka taisak ding hi.
english: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.

paite: Asiampute hotdamna in ka van ding a; amisiangthoute nuamsa in akikou ding uhi.
english: I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.

paite: Huai ah David kii ka selkhesak ding; ka thaunilh a ding in khawnvak ka septa hi.
english: I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.

paite: Amah doute zahlakna in ka van ding a, amah tung ah zaw alallukhu ate sengsung ding, chi in.
english: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”
